mission: To own the Workflow Assessment end to end, from kickoff through the readout that converts a $10,000 diagnosis into an adoption plan, and then run that adoption plan so the partner's team is actually working differently 90 days later. The endgame of the seat: a partner gets the full GPC standard whether or not Grant is on the call.
capacity: All hours in ClickUp by end of day Friday, 100% of weeks. Engagement capacity at full ramp is 4 active WFAs per month plus adoption plan work. Flag Grant and Savannah in advance if a week is trending past your contracted hours.

kpis.name: 1. Interview Quality Score
kpis.calculation: Average score across the 7 PC Interview Rubric categories

kpis.name: 2. Quantified Opportunity Rate
kpis.calculation: Surfaced workflow opportunities with a partner-stated number attached ÷ total opportunities identified

kpis.name: 3. WFA Schedule & Turnaround Compliance
kpis.calculation: % of Engagements completing stakeholder interviews during Interview Week and delivering assessment within 10 business days
kpis.target: ≥90% interviews on schedule; 100% assessments ≤5 business days

kpis.name: 4. Assessment-to-Adoption Conversion Rate
kpis.calculation: WFA readouts converting to signed Adoption Plans within 30 days ÷ total WFA readouts

kpis.name: 5. Adoption Success Rate
kpis.calculation: Adoption engagements with Month 2 Deploy win live and in use by Day 60, paired with renewal rate

kpis.name: 3. Scope Leakage Rate
kpis.calculation: Material out-of-scope work started without documented approval ÷ total scope-change requests

outcomes.howMeasured: Average ≥2.5 / 3.0 across the 7 categories of the PC Interview Rubric (rapport, discovery and process mapping, active listening, AI opportunity ID, teaching and translation, call control, strategic framing). No single category below 2. Every stakeholder interview is scored; a random 2 per engagement are scored by Grant or a peer.

outcomes.what: Pain gets priced in the room
outcomes.howMeasured: ≥80% of surfaced opportunities carry a partner-stated number (hours per week, dollars, error rate, headcount) captured live on the call, not reconstructed after. This is what lets you own the build order instead of the partner's gut.

≥90% of engagements land all 5 or 10 stakeholder interviews inside the contracted Interview Week. Stakeholders named and calendar invites out within 48h of Leadership Kickoff. Every week of slip costs the partner a week of turnaround, so this is the single most important number in the product.
Assessment deliverable to Executive Sponsor and Primary Contact ≤10 business days after the Interview Week closes.

100% of matrix dots trace to a quote, a frequency, or a number from the transcripts. Zero unsourced dots, no exceptions. Deck carries all 8 fixed beats from WFA-Presentation-Guardrails_v1. ≥90% of partners rate readout clarity ≥4 / 5.
≥50% of readouts you present convert to a signed adoption plan within 30 days of the Handoff Walkthrough.

On every adoption plan you run: the Month 2 Deploy win (the top high-impact, low-effort item off that partner's own matrix) is live and in use by day 60, evidenced by usage, not by a demo. ≥70% of adoption plans renew past the 3-month minimum. (Renewal target is an estimate until we have run four of these.)

≥2 merged PRs per month to the skills repo that another consultant can run without asking you a question. Anything you did twice by hand becomes a skill, a checklist, or a prompt. Grant shipped 19 PRs building this thing; the seat is not read-only.

Lead 100% of assigned build-phase client calls; weekly status prepared ≥24h before call containing SOW progress, completed work, upcoming work, blockers, risks, and decisions needed; written next steps sent within 24h after call

competencies.label: Consultative interviewing with pain quantification.
competencies.body: You map the workflow and price it live. "How long does that take, and how often?" is not an optional question. Mapping without sizing is a competent call, not a senior one.

competencies.label: Process decomposition and evidence-traced scoring.
competencies.body: Roles into tasks, tasks into steps, every opportunity scored on impact, effort, and risk, every placement defensible out loud from the partner's own words.

competencies.label: Teaching and translation.
competencies.body: The math-tutor backbone. Explain a technical concept to a non-technical room without making anyone feel stupid. Treat every "I don't know" as a teaching opportunity in disguise: if you do not have the answer, teach the framework for deciding it.

competencies.label: Executive altitude.
competencies.body: When a leader hands you the real strategic fork ("do I shrink the team or expand it"), you take it on and reason the tradeoff out loud. This is the line between a process mapper and someone the owner wants to think with.

competencies.label: Deliverable craft.
competencies.body: One idea per slide, every headline a complete thought, future-state visibly simpler than current-state, the eye directed at the break. The formatting is the argument.

competencies.label: Commercial conversion without the sales voice.
competencies.body: Anchor the retainer with a named number and a 3-month minimum, keep the scope collaborative, and never editorialize the cost of inaction. You report, they conclude.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Tells a partner what will not work before they pay to find out. Delivers the "here is what we are deliberately not recommending, and why" quadrant with intent, because that slide is a trust beat and a skeptic feels it. Gives a teammate the hard note the same week they notice it.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Recommends a tool only when it moves a KPI or removes delivery risk, never because it is new. Reaches for an agent before reaching for a workaround, and expects the company to fund it.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Owns the partner's outcome, not the deliverable. Ships work they would be excited to receive, down to the punctuation. When change management stalls, that is their problem to solve, not evidence the partner is a laggard.

values.label: Build, Sharpen, Scale.
values.body: Turns every engagement into reusable assets so the tenth WFA runs cleaner than the first, and so the consultant running it does not have to be the one who learned it.
